tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ snyan brgyud yang dag zab tig gi smin grol 'bogs pa'i lag len bde chen gsang ba'i bcud 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru shrī he ru kā ya/ srid zhi'i snying po byang chub sems/ /bde chen gsang ba gcig grub kyis/ /ye shes bla ma'i sar sbyor ba/ /lha sngags 'khor lo'i mgon bcas mchod/ snyan brgyud dpal chen yang dag zab tig gi dbang bskur bsgrub pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom ni/ stegs bur dkyil 'khor ras bris sam/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu sngon po gcig bkod pa'i khri'ur rin po che'i snod 'brus bkang ba'i nang du thod sku tshad ldan na bza' mthing gas klubs pa bslangs te bkod/ g.yas su bum pa so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings mthing ga /g.yon du sman gyi pho brang*/ mdun du mar me gsal ba dang*/ gsang dbang thod chang*/ rig tsaka rgyab tu tshe 'brang gi g.yas g.yon du thod par tshe chang dang tshe ril rnams dang*/ sman gtor rak+ta/ phyi mchod rnams spyi 'gre/ las bum/ tshogs dang gtor 'bul sogs dgos pa'i yo byad gzhan yang tshogs par bya'o/ dbang don sgrub mchod ni/ gsol 'debs sogs sngon du 'gro bas gter gzhung gi skyabs sems nas mthar chags su btang zhing*/ bdag mdun dbyer med du bskyed/ bzlas pa'i dbur mdun rten go sar dzab khang dbye ba spyi ltar byas kyang chog /dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du bcas 'bru brgyad ci nus bya/ bum bzlas kyang spro na spyi ltar grub nas sngar dzab khang ma phyes na slar dbye la/ sman phye mar sgrub pa'i dgongs pa gsal btab la bzlas pa gang lcogs/ sman srung spyan 'dren/ dbab bskyil/ dmigs bzlas bcas bya/ de nas bdag dang tshe 'brang gnyis kar dmigs la/ tshe sgrub kyi sgom bzlas tshe 'gugs kyi bar du btang la tshe bcud bsdu/ mchod bstod 'bul/ srung ma'i gtor bsngos bya/ spro na skabs 'dir nyams chags skong ba'i cho ga ltar/ brjod med don bshags/ yig brgya/ lta ba'i klong bshags/ mar me'i skong ba dzab dbyangs bcas byas na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur/

dbang rkyang tsam la ma 'grub kyang chog /gong ltar tshogs byin rlabs nas bsgral bstab yan btang*/ sman gyi dbang bskur blang*/ rig pa'i me tog dor la gnang ba nod/ las bum dbyings phyug ma bskyed bzlas kyis byin brlab bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang gi cho ga ni/ slob ma rnams la khrus/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ sems bskyed gsal gdab sngon tu 'gro bas/ chos bshad mtshams sbyor gyi khyad par/ de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes thugs kyi gsang ba gcig tu bsdus shing rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag tu gyur pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid bde chen phyag rgya mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i mthu rtsal myur ba'i don tu 'bar ba chen po he ru ka'i rnam par snang ba dpal yang dag grub pa gcig pu la rgyud lung gi tshogs zab cing rgya che bar bzhugs pa rnams la brten nas/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rig 'dzin rnams kyis man ngag gi bka' srol du mar bkral ba las/ 'ga' zhig yang dag phyag rgya chen po'i mchog grub pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po pad+mā ka ra dang*/ gnubs kyi dge slong nam mkha'i snying pos gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir spel ba la/ zla gam gcig dang dgu dang nyer gcig dang lnga bcu rtsa brgyad sogs bka' srol mang du byon cing*/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i phyogs su grags pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo/ 'khor lo bde mchog /dgyes pa rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyang mtshan dang sku'i rnam pa gdul bya'i mos blo dang 'tshams par tha dad du bstan pa tsam las/ ngo bo dpal mkha' 'gro sgyu ma yang dag bde ba mchog kho na'i rnam 'gyur du nges pa yin la/ de las skabs su babs pa 'di ni gzhung nyid las/ rgyud dang lung dang man ngag las: dpal chen yang dag sgrub pa'i thabs: bden gnyis tshul du gang bstan pa: snying po'i snying po 'di yin no: zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyud lung man ngag thams cad las bshad pa'i yang dag sgrub thabs ji snyed pa'i snying po gcig tu dril ba 'di ni/

yang dag sgrub pa'i slob dpon nam mkha'i snying po'i ye shes dang dbyer med pa mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa thams cad kyi spyi rje/ sprul pa'i gter chen pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas bka' gter chos sgo rab 'byams kyi bka' babs chen po bdun bzhugs pa'i nang tshan zab mo snyan tu brgyud pa'i chos skor las byon pa ste/ de'ang mdo khams yon tan gnas lnga gcig 'dus rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen por bzhugs pa'i skabs su dag pa'i snang ba 'byams klas pa'i ngang*/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal rang byung mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa'i drung du bka' babs rig 'dzin chen po rnam pa dgus byin gyis brlabs shing rgyud dang sgrub sde'i gdams pa'i snying po rnams kun 'dus rig 'dzin pad+ma bde ba chen po ye shes sku'i rnam rol gcig nyid du mar 'char bas so sor stsal ba las/ 'dir slob dpon chen po rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi dgongs pa bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin pad+ma ka ras rjes su gdams te snyan brgyud du stsal ba dpal chen yang dag zab tig gi smin byed bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /slob dpon dpal chen yang dag he ru ka dngos su gsal ba la mos gus drag pos thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ hoḥ bde chen dgyes par rol pa yi: rdo rje khrag 'thung bdag la dgongs: dbyings rig dbyer med dkyil 'khor du: 'jug cing yongs su smin mdzad gsol: lan gsum/ dpal chen yang dag he ru ka rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rtsa gsum rgyal ba chos srung dang bcas pa mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la bdag sogs sems can thams cad deng nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rtse gcig gus pa chen pos skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ a: skye ba med pa'i ye shes las:

'gags med snang ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: dpal chen yang dag he ru kar: rang ngo shes pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ pha mar gyur pa'i mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang mchog la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed zab mo'i sgor zhugs shing lam rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la brtson par bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ hūm̐: de bzhin nyid dbyings ma rtogs pa'i: 'gro la snying rje chen po'i blos: rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis: khams gsum sgrol bar sems mchog bskyed: lan gsum/ rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du/ zhing mchog dam pa de dag gi spyan sngar tshogs gnyis bsags shing sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang dge rtsa yongs su spel bar byed pa'i don dang ting nge 'dzin rjes su dran pas rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs: dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la: dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: lan gsum/ dbang gi gzhi dgod cing ye shes pa'i byin rlabs dbab pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams lus ngag yid gsum gcun la dmigs pa 'di rtse gcig tu sgoms shig /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhes brjod pa tsam gyis snod rnam par dag pa yum lnga'i mkha' klong 'khyil pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla dregs pa lha chen pho mo'i gdan la/

bcud rnam par dag pa khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung mthing sngon nam mkha'i mdangs can/ zhal gsum g.yas zhal dkar ba g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnge'u chung*/ g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ gar dgu'i nyams can dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs bzhi 'dor thabs su bgrad cing yum badz+ra kro dhī rdo rje dang dung khrag bsnams pas 'khril ba/ phung khams skye mched thams cad ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rdzogs pa'i skur gsal thob cig /slob dpon dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi snang ba chos kyi dbyings kun tu khyab pa 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyang dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya'i rnam par kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos 'dun drag tu mdzod cig /spos rol dang*/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: dzñā na badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ btags pa brjod la dbab/ ye shes pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas par mos shig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes rgya gram mgor bzhag /dbang dngos gzhi la bum pa gsang ba sher ye bzhi pa yongs rdzogs bcas lnga dang*/ mtha' rten gyi dbang rnams su yod pa las/ dang po bum dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ slob dpon dpal he ru ka'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi snang bas dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar sad pa rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas bum pa dpal chen he ru ka'i rten dang brten pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i ngo bos dbang bskur bas/ khyed rang gi phung khams skye mched lha sku phyag rgya chen por gnas gyur/ cir snang lha'i 'khor lor 'char bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rnam bum gyis dbang bskur la/ oṃ: snod bcud yongs rdzogs bum pa'i dbang : dpal chen khrag 'thung phyag rgya'i tshogs: gnyis su med pa'i dbang bskur bas: cir snang lha skur rang shar shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: ka lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: des phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus rtsa'i sgrib pa dag /bskyed rim dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ zhi ba'i las dang rnam smin rig 'dzin 'grub/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can tu byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang gi slad du/ bla ma dpal chen po yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde chen byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun pad+ma bhañdza'i bcud du bskyil ba khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par myangs pas srog rtsol rlung gi rgyu ba thams cad rdo rje'i sngags su gnas gyur/ sgra grags thams cad mi shigs nā da'i rang sgrar 'char bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin la/ āḥ rig pa ye shes he ru ka: dbyings yum kro tī shwa rīr sbyor: zung 'jug byang sems bdud rtsi yis: las rlung sngags su smin par shog: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha hūm̐: des nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag rlung gi sgrib pa dag /bdag byin brlab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ rgyas pa'i las dang tshe dbang rig 'dzin 'grub/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can tu byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ rnam med bde ba chen po'i ye shes rnam bcas phyag rgya'i gzugs su shar ba rigs can mchog gi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i pho nya gzhon nu ma gtad pa dang 'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas kha sbyor gsum gyi stobs kyis thig le bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin tu gnas gyur/

rtog tshogs ye shes chen po'i 'khor lor 'char bar mos shig /rig tsaka gtad la/ hūm̐: 'di ni rnam thar gsum ldan pa: bde chen chos kun 'byung ba'i gnas: brtul zhugs rol pa'i dbang bskur bas: thig le dga' bzhir rdzogs par shog: dzñā na mu dra sid+dhi hūm̐: des gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid thig le'i sgrib pa dag /gzhan lus pho nya'i myur lam bsten pa la dbang*/ dbang gi las dang phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin 'grub/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can tu byas pa yin no/ /bzhi pa tshig dang brda'i dbang gi slad du/ dbyings gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par mtshon pa'i kong bu zlum por/ rig pa'i ye shes 'od du gsal yang rnam par mi rtog pa mtshon pa'i mar mes dbang bskur ba'i brda la brten nas don gyi gnas lugs ka dag zang thal chen po'i ngo bor mnyam par gzhag pas/ snang srid ye shes gzhir bzhengs su gnas gyur/ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid kyis dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs par mos shig /mar me sbar ba snying gar bzhag la/ a: ma 'khrul dbyings kyi kong bu ruḥ rig pa rang snang mar me sbar: gsal la mi rtog dbang bskur bas: gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon gyur shog: dzñā na dhā tu a a a: des snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin pas/ cha mnyam shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don bsgom pa la dbang*/ drag po'i las dang lhun grub rig 'dzin 'grub/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can tu byas pa yin no/ /lnga pa yongs rdzogs chen po'i dbang gi slad du/ dpal chen po'i rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i thod pa'i sku brnyan gyi dbang bskur bas/ snang stong zung 'jug gi dgongs pa mngon tu gyur/

yon tan dang phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang dang byin rlabs rtsal rdzogs su thob par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thod sku gnas lngar bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang cha dpal chen lha yi sku: stong pa zab gsal gnyis med gsung : zung 'jug 'dus ma byas pa'i thugs: yon tan phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: des gsang ba'i phyag rgya yongs rdzogs bhañdza'i pho brang la brten nas yon tan dang phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ phra ba'i sgrib pa bag chags ma lus pa sbyangs/ yon tan dngos grub rnam pa gnyis dang phrin las rab 'byams kyi sgo nas rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis dbang gi dngos gzhi legs par grub nas mtha' rten mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du sgrub pa'i dbang rnam pa gnyis sbyin pa la/ thog mar bdud rtsi sman gyi dbang la 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ sman gyi pho brang dpal chen he ru ka rten dang brten par bcas par gsal ba'i sku'i gnas gsum nas ye shes bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rgyun dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs ye shes chen po'i dngos grub kyi dbyig ma lus pa thob par mos shig

/sman gyi pho brang gnas gsum du bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: snod bcud ye nas bdud rtsi lnga: ma bcos ma bslad he ru ka'i: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dbyig: deng 'dir stsal zhing brtan par mdzod: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra a mṛ ta sid+dhi oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ gi glu dbyangs dang bcas rgya bkrol/ lha rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas rang la bstim/ sman bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil ba sngags tsam gyis phud lha la mchod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta a la la ho: zhes rang gis myong zhing slob ma la sbyin/ de'i yon tan kyang gzhung nyid las: mthong tshor myang ba thams cad kun: lus ngag yid kyi sdig sgrib dag: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob: he ru ka dang dbyer med 'gyur: ces gsungs pa lags so/ /gnyis pa bkra shis tshe'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ a: sngon gyi thugs dam chen po yis: sgrub mchog bdag la brtser dgongs nas: 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi: dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol: gsum/ tshe dbang 'di nyid sger du bskur na skabs 'dir rgyud sbyong ba dang byin dbab pa la sogs spyi ltar bya/ skabs 'dir gong gi rjes 'brel tsam du tshe 'brang gi dbang la 'jug kyang chog rung*/ cung zad spro na/ khyed rang rnams dpal chen yang dag tshe'i bdag po sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa'i thugs kar tshe rten nyi zla'i gwa'ur dwangs srog hūm̐ dmar nṛ yig gis mtshan pa gsal thob/ slob dpon dpal he ru ka tshe'i bdag por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'char ka'i mdangs can lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dang pho nya mgyogs ma'i tshogs nyi zer gyi rdul lta bu spros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba thams cad dang*/ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i bcud dang dwangs ma thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug

/khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i tshe rten dang mdun gyi sgrub rdzas rnams la sib sib thim par mos shig /mda' dar g.yab la/ oṃ: 'chi med rtag pa'i ye shes las: pho nya'i gzugs su rang shar ba: gau rī la sogs lha mo brgyad: dpal chen sku yi klong nas bzhengs: rjes chags dga' bzhi'i cho 'phrul dang : tshad med rnam bzhi'i phyag rgya yis: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba sdus: 'khor 'das 'byung bzhi'i dwangs bcud khug: mi shig thugs kyi thig ler stims: 'chi med sgrub pa'i rdzas la bskyil: rgud pa med pa rdo rje'i lus: 'pho ba med pa rig pa'i tshe: 'gyur ba med pa dbyings kyi srog: rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: tshe 'brang thogs la/ tshe 'brang dpal chen por gsal ba spyi bor byon/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bcud phyag g.yon pa'i thod zhal du bsdus te 'khyil ba las 'phel zhing lud/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sbyangs/ tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub thob par mos shig /oṃ: dbyings nyid gzhon nu bum sku'i klong : rig pa mi 'gyur tshe yi bdag: dpal chen bde gshegs he ru kas: 'gyur med sku yi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: kā ya ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi oṃ: zhes spyi bor bzhag /sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'chi med tshe'i dbang mchog lha dang gnyis su med par thob par gyur cig /tshe chang bdud rtsi myangs bas rtsa khams ye shes kyi dwangs mas khyab/ rlung bcu dbu mar thim/ mi shigs pa rdo rje'i srog tu grub par mos shig /thod pa'i bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag cing sbyin la/ āḥ dbyings kyi ngo bo ka pā lar: rig pa byang sems bdud rtsir 'khyil:

dpal chen pad+ma he ru kas: 'gags med gsung gi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: wā ka ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi āḥ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'chi med tshe'i dbang mchog lha dang gnyis su med pa thob par gyur cig /tshe'i ril bu dpal chen tshe'i bdag po'i ye shes 'od kyi thig le 'khor 'das stong srog mi shigs pa'i bdag nyid can khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas zhugs/ snying ga'i dwangs srog la thim/ 'od zer gyis lus thams cad khyab pas gzung 'dzin 'chi 'pho'i rtog pa sbyangs/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ye shes mngon tu byas par mos shig /tshe ril snying gar gtugs/ khar sbyin la/ hūm̐: mi shigs thig le dbyings kyi ngang : rig pa dwangs ma'i bcud du 'dril: dpal chen rdo rje he ru kas: 'pho med thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: tsit+ta ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'chi med tshe'i dbang mchog lha dang gnyis su med pa thob par gyur cig /de ltar 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang thams cad 'khor 'das kyi tshe dpal bcud kyi dwangs mas gang ba'i snying po'i yang bcud thams cad snying ga'i tshe rten mi shigs pa'i thig ler thim pas bkrag mdangs 'od du 'bar/ nyi zla'i ga'u kha bsgrigs pa la dwangs ma'i 'od lnga rdo rje'i mdud pas bsnol mar bcings par mos shig /aḥ 'gags pa med pa rig pa'i tshe: skye ba med pa'i dbyings su thim: zung 'jug 'dus ma byas pa'i srog: ye shes snying por rgyas gdab bo: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: dzñā na gar+bha a a: zhes rgyas gdab/ ye dhar dang shis brjod rgyas par bya zhing me tog 'thor/ de dag rnams kyis dpal chen yang dag zab tig gi smin byed rjes 'brel bcas tshang bar grub pa lags/

de'i grol byed khrid kyi rim pa zab mo zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ de'ang gzhung nyid las/ bla med mchog gi ye shes ni: myur du 'char ba'i thabs chen po: gud du sbas pa'i thugs khrid 'di: snod ldan nges pa can la ston: ces dpal chen yang dag gi gzhung chen po rnams su'ang dbang bzhi'i lam gyi rkang tshang ba'i khrid dkyus gcig tu bstan pa nyung bas shin tu zab cing dkon pa'i thugs khrid 'di nyid gang la 'chad pa'i snod bstan pa sngon tu 'gro bas/ bstan bya'i khrid tshul dngos la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa gsum gyis bstan/ sngon 'gro la ring ba dang nye ba'i sbyor ba sngon tu song nas/ thun mong blo ldog rnam bzhis rgyud sbyang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyis gzhi bting*/ thun mong ma yin pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gcig brgyud mas byin rlabs 'bebs par bstan/ dngos gzhi lta sgom spyod gsum las/ lta ba yang dag gdod ma'i gnas lugs blo 'das chen por la bzla/ sgom pa dbyibs kyi rim pas sprul sku/ sngags kyi ṛm pas longs sku/ chos kyi ṛm pas chos skur rdzogs par byed/ spyod pa yid rig dang las kyi phyag rgya'i brtul zhugs la brten nas lta sgom gyi bogs 'don par bstan/ rjes kyi ṛm pa/ lta sgom spyod pa de ltar nyams su blangs pas lam lnga rim par bgrod cing mthar thug mchog gi 'bras bu la sbyor ba'i tshul ngo sprod du bstan pa rnams kyis bsdus pa ste/ de lta bu'i don rgyas par ston pa rtsa ba rdo rje'i gsung 'di ltar lags/ dbang thob dam tshig rnam par dag: tshe gcig byang chub don gnyer bas: dben sar 'jig rten bya ba btang : bde ba'i stan 'dug rlung ro bsal: dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che dang : mi rtag myur du 'jigs par bsam: las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin bya: 'khor bar yid dbyung drag tu bskyed: rang gzhan sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir:

skyabs song byang chub mchog sems bzung : khyad par byin rlabs 'bebs pa ni: aḥ snod bcud 'dzin zhen dbyings su thim: snang srid zhing khams chen po'i dbus: rang mdun nam mkhar 'od lnga'i klong : seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: rang 'od snyems ma'i bde bas dgyes: dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: thugs kar ye shes snying po'i srog: dpal chen yang dag he ru ka: mthing nag rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin: yab yum mnyam sbyor khro bo'i chas: bde drod me phung 'bar ba'i klong : dregs pa pad nyi'i gdan la 'gying : 'od zer gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dbyings las rig pa rang shar ba: bla ma dpal chen zhi khro'i lhar: phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: sdig sgrib nyes ltung snying nas bshags: dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul: rtag par bzhugs gsol dge rtsa kun: yang dag byang chub snying por bsngo: rdo rje'i ye shes myur 'grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'khor 'das snod bcud dpal 'byor dang : bdag lus phung khams skye mched bcas: gzung 'dzin rnam dag maṇ+ḍa las: bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: oṃ sarba rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza āḥhūm̐: thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ yig mthar: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi rgyun: char ltar babs te rang la thim: nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams chags sbyangs: bde chen ye shes rgyas par gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhes pa'i sngags kyis thugs rgyud bskul: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: rig pa ye shes gzugs kyi sku: bla ma dpal chen zhi khro'i lha: skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid la: snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs shing : thugs dam zab mo'i rgyud bskul na: byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma rje:

dngos grub stsol cig yi dam lha: bde chen dbang skur mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sgo gsum smin cing grol ba dang : 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yang yang bskul zhing gsol gdab mthar: rigs kun khyab bdag zhi khro'i lha: snyoms zhugs byang chub sems kyi rgyun: spyi bo nas brgyud gnas bzhir babs: dbang bzhi'i ye shes 'phel bar bsam: dmigs med brjod bral ngang du bzhag: de nas dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la: lta sgom spyod pa rnam gsum bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhi khro sgrags sgrub 'di chig brgyud kho na'o zhes ḍā ki nī dgyes pa'i glu las thos so/ /mchan/ ste: lta ba rig stong gnyug ma'i bab: yang dag grub pa gcig pu ni: sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa: blo 'das chen por la bzla'o: sgom pa rnal 'byor zab mo'i lam: sprul sku rdzogs byed dbyibs kyi rim: rang byung sngags kyi sgra gdangs las: dpal chen khrag 'thung phyag rgyar brtag: chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal: rtse gcig sems bzung nga rgyal brtan: gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med pa: rang bzhin yongs grub dag pa dran: skabs su rlung gi sbyor bas 'ching : res 'ga' mi dmigs ngang du klod: skabs su rdo rje'i gsang sngags bzla: sku dang 'od zer spro bsdu yis: ting 'dzin rtsal sbyangs phrin las 'grub: longs sku rdzogs byed sngags kyi rim: lus gnad chun btsal rlung dug dbyung : rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ldan gsal: 'khrul 'khor bya zhing lam sbyangs te: lte ba'i bum can rtse gcig brtan: de goms gtum mo sbar ba'i mes: haṃ bzhu drod dang bde ba bskyed: mthar ni dbu ma'i stong ngang bsdu: mi rtog ngang du yun ring bzhag: chos sku rdzogs byed chos kyi rim: snying dbus mi shigs thig le la: zag pa med pa'i bde ba bstim: rtse gcig sems bzung zin pa na: 'od zer gzha' tshon lta bu'i sprin: ro rkyang lam brgyud snod bcud khyab:

bde ba chen po'i ngang du zhu: tshur 'dus snying ga'i thig ler bstim: de nyid kho nar rten byas te: dus gsum rtog pa'i rgyun lugs bcad: da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma: rig stong khyab brdal chen po'i ngang : bcas bcos spro bsdu bral bar bzhag: 'jam rlung bzung zhing phyi nang gi: dbyings rig bsres te lam du khyer: de ltar nyams su blang ba las: rtags dang rtags can 'od gsal dang : tshor ba thams cad bde bar 'char: rtsol med rlung sems zin pa na: bogs 'don yid kyi rig ma dang : de goms las kyi phyag rgya la: spyod pa'i brtul zhugs mthar dbyung ngo : de las 'bras bu mngon byed tshul: ngo sprod rjes kyi rim pa ni: rlung sems dbu mar 'du ba'i nyams: zab mo tshogs kyi lam yin te: gnas pas drod kyi ye shes skye: thim pa'i rang rtsal rdzogs pa las: bde ba chen po mngon byas te: de nyid stong par rig pa yis: zung 'jug 'phags pa'i bden pa mthong : dbu ma'i mdud grol rlung sems thim: thig le zag med bde bar shar: sa dang lam kun mngon byas te: rnam thar bzhi ldan sku bzhi'i bdag: he ru ka dpal tshe 'dir 'grub: ces 'chad nus na legs par bshad/ mi nus na go brda 'phrod nges dal bar bklags la/ zhes gsungs pa'i don rnams nyams su blangs nas rgyud la tshul bzhin tu sbyor bar mdzod cig /de rnams kyis dpal chen yang dag zab tig gi dbang khrid dkyus gcig tu grub pa lags pas sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la dam tshig khas blang phyin dbang gi rjes rim spyi ltar bya/ slob dpon gyis rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma/ gtor skyong*/ bro brdung rnams song nas/ dkyil 'khor la gtang rag mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ bsdu ldangs bsngo smon shis brjod kyi bar las byang gzhung ltar byas pas 'grub bo/ /cir snang dpal chen phyag rgyar rnam par dag /dus sbyor rgyu ba 'bru brgyad gser phreng rdzogs/

/sems dang sems byung bde chen thig ler smin/ /khams gsum 'khrul pa dbyings su ru ldog shog /rim pa gnyis phrin las dang bcas pa'i snying po bsdus shing khyer bde bas ngo mtshar u dum+ba ra'i dpal yon 'dzin pa'i smin grol 'bogs tshul chu 'babs su bkod pa 'di'ang 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen por bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
